title: Renew an RSA or RCG competency card
summary: Learn how to renew your Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) or Responsible Conduct of Gambling (RCG) competency card online.
intro:
Your Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) and/or Responsible Conduct of Gambling (RCG) competency card is valid for 5 years. Approximately 3 months before your card is due to expire you'll receive a renewal reminder notice by email or SMS.

You need to do online refresher training to renew. When you've completed the training your new card will be valid for a further 5 years.

You can access a digital version of your competency card through the Service NSW app.

For up-to-date information, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW: Training.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor and gaming training contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: Must complete online refresher training to renew the card.
what_you_need: Your competency card holder (CCH) licence number
Your renewal number (found on your email or SMS notification)

how_to_steps.text: Enter your licence number and renewal number.
If you don't have your renewal number, select 'Don't have?' and enter your name, birth date and postcode.
Complete the appropriate refresher training course/s.
Confirm or edit your contact details.
Make your payment by credit card (Visa or Mastercard).
You'll receive a confirmation email with your receipt/interim certificate.
Your new card will be posted to you within 5 weeks.

more_info.text: Each refresher training course takes about 45 minutes to complete.

If you have both RSA and RCG competencies, the renewal date on your card is determined by the date you completed the first course. For example, if you have an RSA competency card issued on 1 January 2018, it will expire on 31 December 2023. If you complete an RCG course on 15 January 2020, both RSA and RCG competencies will expire on 31 December 2023.
If you didn't receive a renewal notice, then your personal details may not be up to date. You can update your details using this online form.
Only refresher training provided online by Liquor & Gaming can renew your card. If your card is still current, you cannot renew it by repeating full courses at approved training organisations.
You can find more information on the competency card renewal process on the Liquor & Gaming NSW website.

faqs.q: How long is an RSA or RCG competency card valid for?
faqs.a: Your competency card is valid for 5 years.

faqs.q: How will I know when my card is due to expire?
faqs.a: You will receive a renewal reminder notice by email or SMS approximately 3 months before it expires.

faqs.q: What do I need to do to renew my card?
faqs.a: You must complete online refresher training to renew your card.
